## Change

Describe the behavior changed and why. Note anything intentionally out of scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Build, types, unit/script tests, lint, format, and documentation checks passed.
- [ ] Relevant browser and offline-proof checks passed, or the gap is explained.
- [ ] Report links identify this revision and run; failures and skips are visible.
- [ ] Changed manifest references were regenerated and reviewed.

## Risk

Describe compatibility, security, dependency, and user-data risks. Include the
rollback approach and any verification not performed. Keep raw ledgers and secrets
out of the PR. Source publication, GitHub settings, and releases need explicit
owner approval; passing checks are not independent peer review.
